newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Jan 22.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Jan 22.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bangladesh press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

The Petrobangla (the state gas and petroleum agency) has chalked out a plan to develop the recently discovered gas field in Salda area under Kasba thana on an emergency basis and under a "tight budget."
U.S. Assistant Secretary of State Robin Raphel arrives in Dhaka tomorrow on a six-day working visit.

The whole country plunged yesterday into an unprecedented power crisis due to shortfall in electricity generation. The total loadshedding was about 750 MW yesterday while the Power Development Board claimed it would not be more than 325 MW.
A memorandum of undertanding on a joint venture to develop the Chittagong port was signed yesterday at the office of the Chittagong Chamber of Commerce and Industry.

Former president Hossain Mohammad Ershad said on Tuesday that his Jatiya Party wants to set an example of a "constructive and responsible" opposition politics going beyond the traditional political culture.

Secretary-general of opposition Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP), Abdul Mannan Bhuiyan, on Tuesday called on the nationalist forces to thwart the conspiracy hatched by the "neoautocratic government" to sell the country's independence and sovereignty.
Supply of sugarcane in unexpectedly low volume in the mills is apprehended to cause a shortfall of about 150,000 tonnes of sugar in current year (1996-97).

The visiting high-powered Chinese delegation on trade and investment said in Chittagong on Tuesday that there were many areas in Bangladesh such as fisheries, agriculture and tourism which could be developed through cooperative efforts of the two countries.
